title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E07 — The "Missingest" Man in America
In 1930, a New York Supreme Court justice with close ties to Tammany Hall, and future president Franklin Delano Roosevelt, steps out of a steakhouse and disappears; for decades, the case dominates mainstream media and remains unsolved.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Hunt for Adolf Eichmann: WWII Edition
At the end of World War II, many Nazi officials were captured and tried for their crimes; but one of the architects of the Holocaust, Adolf Eichmann, slipped through the cracks, repeatedly eluding Nazi hunters from around the globe.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Amber Room: WWII Edition
One of World War II's greatest unsolved mysteries: an incomparable work of art worth half a billion dollars, lost without a trace; perhaps the single most valuable object the Nazis ever stole, the quest for this treasure has lasted over 75 years.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

One of Germany's top military minds during WWII, General Erwin Rommel The Desert Fox, tears through North Africa.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

Five years after John F. Kennedy is killed by gunshot, his brother Robert meets the same fate; an assassin's bullet again changes the course of history, and the latest clues in the case are riddled with inconsistencies.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S02 E03 — The Death of Bruce Lee
On July 20, 1973, martial arts superstar Bruce Lee dies under mysterious circumstances in Hong Kong, China.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

When the British Red Coats march into Lexington in 1775 prepared for a surprise attack, they are met with a small scrappy militia ready for a fight; it's the battle that kicked off the American Revolution.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E06 — The Holy Grail
It's a treasure coveted by everyone from Roman emperors to Adolf Hitler; a sacred object said to hold incredible powers of healing, resurrection and immortality, the Holy Grail is the most sought-after relic in the world.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E10 — The Hindenburg Disaster
For decades experts believe they know what caused the Hindenburg disaster: that leaking hydrogen--causing the airship to burst into flames; but there may be more to this story.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E01 — The Loch Ness Monster
Despite centuries of sightings and searches, one deep-sea monster remains unidentified; as evidence continues to mount, the mystery endures whether the Loch Ness monster exists.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E19 — Unlocking the Secrets of the Nazca Lines
They've been called the world's greatest archaeological enigma: 2,000-year-old geoglyphs made in the Peruvian desert that span over 50 miles; the drawings are so massive, they can only be seen from the air.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

John Dillinger's life consists of brazen bank robberies across the country, but his death remains shrouded in mystery; what really happened to John Dillinger?

title: The UnXplained

Many believe it to be the Word of God, but others claim it contains inconsistencies and contradictions that could only be manmade.

title: The UnXplained

Genius is widely considered to be the ability to change the world in an incredible way, like inventing new technology, deciphering the mysteries of the universe, or creating transcendent art, but its origin is a mystery.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E10 — Mysteries of the Missing Link
More than 7 billion people live on Earth; human civilizations span the globe; although many around the globe believe that the divine hand of God placed humans on Earth, others question whether there were ever other kinds of human-like creatures.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S03 E03 — The Search for the Ark of the Covenant
Throughout history, many have sought the lost Ark of the Covenant; according to the Old Testament, God himself instructed Moses to build the Ark, and it is believed that it held the power of the Almighty.

title: The UnXplained

A miraculous meteorite falling from the heavens and a chunk of sandstone considered so sacred that wars have been fought to protect it; throughout history, many have insisted that simple stones can do everything from choosing a king to causing death.

title: The UnXplained
description:

Africa is the birthplace of humanity and remains one of the most mysterious continents on Earth, featuring everything from lost cities buried beneath shifting sands to abandoned ruins steeped in fascinating folklore.

title: The UnXplained
description:

The age-old question of what happens after death and the clues to the answer may lie in unusual cases of near-death experience, reincarnation, and how memories can be passed from organ donors to transplant recipients.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E12 — Objects of Power
For centuries, certain objects have been deemed to heal the sick, summon spirits, legitimize kings, curse their owners, and even alter the fate of nations.

title: The UnXplained
description:

Throughout history, humans have buried their dead in caves or chambers, in pyramids or in some form of a tomb; ancient tombs were visual memorials for the dead; in China, a vast necropolis was constructed as a way to connect to the afterlife.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E16 — Amazing Animal Abilities
A dog that can detect cancer faster than doctors can do it by using sophisticated equipment; a horse that can read minds; birds that can sense disaster days before it happens.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E02 — Nightmares and Dreams
Dreams have inspired humanity for thousands of years and in all this time, we have yet to answer one fundamental question: What is the purpose of dreams? From nightmares linked to unexplained deaths and more.

title: The UnXplained
description:

A look at what could cause once-thriving groups of people to just abandon their great cities, never to return; modern scientific knowledge may be able to help answer the unsolved questions surrounding these lost civilizations.

description:
S24 E08 — Pinky's Big Day
Rick, Corey and Chum look back at some of the most adorable moments from Gold & Silver Pawn Shop's fuzziest employee--Pinky the Pomeranian.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S21 E09 — Jumpin' Jake Flash
A set of replica Muppets has Chum feeling green with envy; Rick flips over an autograph book from the 1800s; a pair of pants supposedly worn by Keith Richards; Rick pops over to an L.A. gallery.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S22 E05 — Pawns N' Roses
Rick and Chum rack up points testing the merchandise at a pinball paradise; Corey saddles up to a piece of World War II history; Chum sleuths out a sale on a set of Sherlock Holmes books; Rick welcomes Guns N' Roses guitarist, ASHBA.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S22 E06 — You're a Good Man, Chumlee Russell
A seller brings in a WWF prototype figurine; Rick takes a stab at a 19th century knife pistol; Corey attempts to smoke out a deal on a lighter from Frank Sinatra's hotel; Chum finds an original 1965 A Charlie Brown Christmas soundtrack album.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S21 E08 — May the Miniforce Be With You
A seller comes in with two "Star Wars" Lego minifigures; Rick and Chum mosey on down to Texas, where WWE Champion Booker T helps them authenticate a pair of wrestling boots; Rick checks out a Jeff Koons Balloon Dog statue.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S21 E03 — Rarer Than Hen's Teeth
Rick and Chum show off their pearly whites when a seller brings in a pair of Tyrannosaur teeth; Corey goes to bat for a signed Mark Buehrle jersey; a set of "M*A*S*H" action figures is on Rick's radar.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S20 E05 — Fender Vendor
Rick looks at a Honus Wagner baseball card; Chum strums a custom Fender by guitar maker John Carruthers; Rick is thrilled to see a Draped Bust half dollar hit the counter.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S22 E08 — Extrasensory Pawn-ception
Turtlemania hits the shop when a seller tries to pawn a 1991 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles action figure and prototype; Rick heads to the gun range to test out a deadly 1800s "manstopper" pistol; a model of the Las Vegas Desert Inn hotel.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S21 E05 — Chum Goes to Hollywood
Rick tackles a football helmet signed by 28 Heisman Trophy winners; Corey gears up to buy a devastatingly cool "Transformers" toy for the shop; Rick tries not to go psycho over an Alfred Hitchcock poster that makes a cameo in the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S21 E11 — The Big Dig
Time's a-ticking when a seller brings a Mr. T wall clock to the shop; Rick checks out James Bond's credit card from the 2006 movie Casino Royale; Corey plays with an Atomic Cannon toy; Chum and Rick get down and dirty in Texas looking for fossils.

title: Pawn Stars
description:

Corey and Chumlee rock out with personal memorabilia from AC/DC front man Angus Young; Hollywood rebel James Dean's ID bracelet finds its way into the shop; Rick heads East hoping to score big with a rare relic from World War II.
